content:
Maria D.: heads-up: seeing a short spike of 502s hitting hostedapi-eu1 around 09:04-09:06 UTC, mostly for streaming endpoints. first noticed in customer X dashboards :eyes:
Ravi K.: thx, any timelines? can you paste a sample request id or curl?
Maria D.: req ids: r-0a1b2c3d, r-0a1b2c3e. curl repro (sanitized):
Maria D.: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 'https://api.eu1.redwood.com/v1/stream?model=gpt-large' -d '{"prompt":"test"}'```
SRE-Platform: got the ids, checking edge logs now. Initial glance: a flurry of 502s from edge -> midfront with "upstream reset" + connection window errors.
SRE-Platform: timeline shows a sudden burst at 09:04:12 UTC that lasted ~90s, concurrent connections jumped ~4x on those frontdoor boxes.
Jess L.: did any deploys or token rotations happen around that time?
Maria D.: no deploys on prod. Customer auth rotation started at 09:03:40 for some tenants but should be independent.
Ravi K.: hmm could be keepalive/conn window jitter during auth rotation. I've seen auth rotations cause midfront to drop idle windows when many clients reconnect.
Support Bot: alert: gateway-502-rateburst detected on hostedapi-eu1 (severity: medium). linked runbook: /runbooks/edge-502s-windows.json
SRE-Platform: repro notes: non-stream (short) requests unaffected, long-poll/stream requests show early upstream RST from midfront pool when conncount crosses ~1200. stack traces show envoy reset on WINDOW_UPDATE with error code PROTOCOL_ERROR in a few traces.
Jess L.: can we confirm whether nginx or envoy closed first? traceroute isn't helping. need tcpdump on midfront -> runtime for a sample span.
Ravi K.: I'm pulling tcpdump now for midfront-02. quick mitigation: increase midfront h2 conn window and backoff retry window to reduce sharp reconnect fanout, and temporarily route heavy-stream tenants to alternate pool.
Maria D.: doing temporary route change for customer X to pool-bypass-alt, will monitor. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: route change applied to tenant X -> pool-bypass-alt (rollout id r-out-992).
SRE-Platform: after route change, 502s for that tenant dropped to normal levels within one minute. overall cluster still showing a few stray 502s from other tenants in same time window.
Ravi K.: planned next steps: 1) add jittered reconnect for client-side token rotation (ask SDK) 2) increase midfront h2 initial window + tune envoys to avoid immediate RESET on WINDOW_UPDATE 3) add guardrail to throttle bursts from a single tenant at edge.
Jess L.: I'll open an issue for SDK jitter (DEVEX-1287). Maria, can you collect packet captures & envoy traces for entire 09:03:30-09:07:00 window and attach to the ticket?
Maria D.: uploading pcap + envoy traces now to the support ticket. link: https://internal.redwood/support/tickets/54821 (private)
Support Bot: ticket 54821 updated with attachments.
SRE-Platform: follow-up: midfront shows intermittent memory pressure on those boxes (old GC cycle), will schedule rolling restart and bump container memory for pool-bypass-alt to avoid thrash.
Ravi K.: timeline target: roll restart within next 2 hours, config tweak deployed to staging for verification.
Jess L.: Customer X notified via support: "We've applied a temporary routing change and are investigating root cause; will follow up with RCA."
Maria D.: customer acknowledged, asked for ETA on permanent fix.
Ravi K.: estimate: 48-72h for full mitigation (SDK jitter + config roll + rolling restart), will shorten if we confirm the exact trigger.
SRE-Platform: adding additional observability: per-tenant conncounts and h2 window-change alerts. will post updates here after restart.
Maria D.: thanks all — will keep monitoring and update ticket. :white_check_mark:
